body: GET /api/version: per-area fingerprints (tree, documents, comments, config) from file size+mtime, cached 2 s. UI polls every 5 s while visible (and on tab focus) plus a Refresh button; refreshes only changed areas, keeps selection, expanded branches, scroll position, active search and open document; open ticket edit and document drafts are never replaced (warning shown, saving uses the revision check); removed tickets/documents are explained. Verified in Chromium with CLI writes while the UI was open.
author: claude
